mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_MESSAGE (TICKER, USER_EMAIL, NICKNAME, CONTENT, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{ticker}, #{userEmail}, #{nickname}, #{content}, UTC_TIMESTAMP())
mapper.select: SELECT MSG_ID, TICKER, SENDER_ID, NICKNAME, CONTENT, CREATED_AT FROM ( SELECT C.MSG_ID, C.TICKER, U.USER_ID AS SENDER_ID, C.NICKNAME, C.CONTENT, DATE_FORMAT(C.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS CREATED_AT, C.CREATED_AT AS RAW_CREATED_AT FROM CHAT_MESSAGE C LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.EMAIL = C.USER_EMAIL WHERE C.TICKER = #{ticker} ORDER BY RAW_CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) AS recent ORDER BY RAW_CREATED_AT ASC
